title: Guaranteed bounds on the simulated resistance of thin-layer device structures: scripts
description: Scripts that reproduce every figure, table and number of 'Guaranteed bounds on the simulated resistance of thin-layer device structures: contact resistance on thin films and isolation sheets' by H. Talleb, A. Elomari and M. Ben Chouikha (submitted to the Journal of Computational Electronics, 2026). A potential solution and a current solution computed on the same stretched mesh enclose the exact two-terminal resistance of the model between a lower and an upper bound. Applications: contact resistance of a contact on a thin film (transfer-length structure) and isolation sheet in a three-layer silicon stack.
